name: agent-sizing
about: Chat sizes each agent to its task (8 Nov 2026, agents/sizing.rs): in a Code chat on lab-sandbox, a trivial change (rename a variable), then a hard one (find why the tests fail now and then, and fix it). Soft checks on the agents' model and effort, since they're the model's judgement: the trivial one small (Haiku or Sonnet, at low or medium), the hard one big (Opus or Fable, at high or above). Its `fake` steps size them as the guide says, so a --fake lab checks the plumbing: the chat's pick reaches the agent's turn, with why.

steps.note: No ask-first card, and no ceiling ("No limit", the default).

args.brief: Rename the function cupsToMl to cupsToMillilitres in src/convert.js and its test, then run the tests.
args.title: Rename cupsToMl

A trivial, mechanical change: a small agent (Haiku or low effort; Sonnet at medium at most).

args.title: Fix the flaky tests
